title: feedback row
description: Anyone proposes, only gyb rules, everyone reads (03 L141). Field table 03 L143-152; 09 copies the same table.

id.description: fb-NNNN per proxy decision D-11 (03 L145 only says 'feedback id')

status.description: 03 L141; accepted and rejected are terminal, the same row takes no further version, propose again as a new row (09 L73; sync-inbox Q37(f) L231)

target.description: a file path, or a prefixed number rule-06 / principle-06; for one row of a table give the file path and name the row in text (03 L146; sync-inbox Q37(f) L231)

verdict_text.description: required on both accepted and rejected: what was adopted, or why not (03 L148)

applied_to.description: required on accepted, at least one path, rl checks each path exists (03 L149, L152)

rules_version_after.description: filled by rl on accept (03 L150)
